rationale: Build on the current best recurrent-tail script with a compact float-budget reallocation instead of another scalar sweep. The change keeps `attn.c_v.weight` in fp16 for every recurrent tail block during final int8 export, extending the already-proven q/k rescue to the full recurrent attention path while preserving the same training loop, recurrence curriculum, and exact final evaluation path. This directly targets a still-promising local category: recurrent-tail float rescue near the 16 MB cap.
title: Dual Recurrent-Tail QKV FP16 Rescue
